description:
Semantic UI kanban extension — adds the `kanban` node type: UiKanban, a
        board of lanes holding cards, rendered by a TypeScript painter in the
        browser and a Handlebars template on the server. The browser painter
        adds the one thing a page cannot do without JavaScript: dragging a
        card to another lane, which fires the board's trigger with the card,
        the lane it left and the lane it landed in.
